## UI Standards (Required for UI changes)

- [ ] Uses shadcn primitives from @/components/ui/* before custom wrappers
- [ ] Uses semantic tokens for color/surface (no hardcoded hex/rgb or raw Tailwind palette colors)
- [ ] Uses approved text opacity hierarchy (text-foreground, text-foreground/75, text-foreground/50)
- [ ] Meets accessibility baselines (keyboard nav, visible focus, labels, ARIA for non-semantic interactions)
- [ ] Includes dark-mode and responsive checks for changed UI
